name: Curated 2D Platformer Seed Registry
description: Small offline-friendly seed pack for the platformer demo. Local fixture PNGs keep validation deterministic; provenance points to CC0 platformer candidates.

provenance.origin: Kenney Pixel Platformer lists 200 files, 18x18 tile size, and Creative Commons CC0. The committed spritesheet was extracted from the official kenney_pixel-platformer.zip download.
provenance.notes: Character spritesheet uses 24x24 cells with 1px spacing; default sprite is the first green player idle frame.

provenance.origin: Kenney Pixel Platformer lists 200 files, 18x18 tile size, and Creative Commons CC0. The committed tilemap was extracted from the official kenney_pixel-platformer.zip download.
provenance.notes: Main tile sheet uses 18x18 cells with 1px spacing. This entry exposes terrain, hazards, props, and collectibles for Unity multiple-sprite import.

provenance.origin: Kenney Pixel Platformer lists 200 files, 18x18 tile size, and Creative Commons CC0. The committed tilemap was extracted from the official kenney_pixel-platformer.zip download.
provenance.notes: Collectible entry reuses the main tile sheet with collectible-focused named slices for coins, gems, and keys.

provenance.origin: Kenney Pixel Platformer lists 200 files, 18x18 tile size, and Creative Commons CC0. The committed background tilemap was extracted from the official kenney_pixel-platformer.zip download.
provenance.notes: Background sheet uses 24x24 cells with 1px spacing for sky, cloud, mountain, and foliage backdrop tiles.

provenance.origin: Kenney Platformer Art Deluxe and OpenGameArt mirror both identify the pack as CC0 platformer/tile art.

provenance.origin: OpenGameArt mirror describes separate PNG sprites and HUD/UI images under CC0.

provenance.origin: OpenGameArt entry lists 2D sunny grassland platformer sprites under CC0/Public Domain with tree and cloud decorations.

provenance.origin: OpenGameArt entry lists Platformer Assets by theMinesAreShakin under CC0 with simple VVVVVV-clone PNG assets including tiles.png.
provenance.notes: HTTP-backed candidate kept lower priority than local fixtures; use tags simple/vvvvvv to opt into this minimal tile style.

provenance.origin: OpenGameArt entry lists Platformer Assets by theMinesAreShakin under CC0 with simple VVVVVV-clone PNG assets including coin.png.

provenance.origin: OpenGameArt entry lists Sci-fi platformer tileset by Buch under CC0; page describes a 16x16 platformer tileset with robots, levers, and an alternate palette.

provenance.origin: Liberated Pixel Cup/OpenGameArt entry lists Grass/Dead Grass Platformer Tileset by PROWNE under CC0 and describes live/dead grass tiles plus character frames.
